title: Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Product Sheet: Tokens, Data Validity and Rewards Earning
content:
What a delivered Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay order produces differs by product: whether delivery produces a token code sent to the customer and how many digits it has, how long a data bundle stays usable after delivery, and whether the delivered order can earn Paloma Rewards points.

| Product | Delivery produces a token code sent to the customer | Digits in the token code | Days a data bundle stays usable after delivery | Delivered order can earn Paloma Rewards points |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | no | 0 (no token) | 0 (not applicable) | yes |
| Paloma Data Bundle | no | 0 (no token) | 30 | yes |
| Paloma Electricity Token | yes | 20 | 0 (not applicable) | yes |
| Paloma Bill Pay Utilities | no | 0 (no token) | 0 (not applicable) | yes |
| Paloma Bill Pay Television | no | 0 (no token) | 0 (not applicable) | yes |
| Paloma Bill Pay School Fees | no | 0 (no token) | 0 (not applicable) | no |

## Product notes

- **Paloma Electricity Token** is the only product whose delivery produces a token code; the code has 20 digits.
- **Paloma Data Bundle** is the only product with a usage period: the bundle stays usable for 30 days after delivery.
- **Paloma Bill Pay School Fees** is the only product whose delivered orders do not earn Paloma Rewards points; delivered orders of the other five products can earn them.

## Illustrations (hypothetical orders)

- A delivered Paloma Electricity Token order: a 20-digit token code is produced and sent to the customer.
- A delivered Paloma Airtime Top-Up order: no token code is produced and no usage period applies; the order can earn Paloma Rewards points.
- A delivered Paloma Bill Pay School Fees payment: no token code, and no Paloma Rewards points.
